notes.title: NOVA LANDS - Our next game, is out now!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1501610/Nova_Lands/

We're very happy to announce our next game is OUT NOW!

Prepare for an exhilarating journey to Nova Lands! Gear up and board the ship, but before we land, let's get a glimpse of what awaits us on this vibrant planet.

Remember your mission: Earth needs a new source of energy, and you're the one to find and deliver it. Simple, right? Well, first, let's establish a sturdy base!

[h3]1. Extract resources, construct buildings, and unlock more goodies!
[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40824259/5187b4ca8bacbb325aef461ff6cb3363cdf5503e.gif[/img]

[h3]2. Research, research & research! Expand your knowledge and unlock advanced technologies.
[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40824259/a4f9e4026612cdc07fdb3cf02eee90cc87ef8409.gif[/img]

[h3]3. Explore Nova Lands' captivating world!
[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40824259/fb67f4c703063d65446bd28913b636a5855f188a.gif[/img]

[h3]4. Team up with NPCs, assist them, and get awesome upgrades!
[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40824259/849d2cebe90530546c1be0173ed15d14966f0eb6.gif[/img]

[h3]5. Interact with the fauna: live in peace or unleash your destructive side!
[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40824259/89c3bf5cc1f4af1f0e4e083a8888684dfda414dd.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40824259/dc4492438da7968f6afe17049f9eec9550704c11.gif[/img]

[h3]6. Use cute bots to automate your industry!
[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40824259/778385fc2597dba13235c947701763314286dd52.gif[/img]

[h3]7. When you think you completed all the things to do on the planet, visit the Space Station for new activities, shops, and lively NPCs!
[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40824259/0b9801277e005a72fb181c9b6ea56f8513ff1587.gif[/img]

Nova Lands is out right now, so check it out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1501610/Nova_Lands/

notes.title: Update 1.1.11 - Controller Hotfix
notes.content:
Some players have been experiencing a problem with specific controllers when changing the game controls.
We appreciate the patience and all the details on the reports that are helping us track this down.

[h2]This update should avoid any player to be locked on the start screen.[/h2]

Important:
[list]
[*] If you're locked on the start screen, try disconnecting your controller and progressing with mouse and keyboard.
[*] Make sure you're playing the 1.1.11 version.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.1.10 - Hotfix
notes.content:
[h1]BUG:[/h1]
Some types of controllers are totally unresponsive after trying to remap the buttons

notes.title: Update 1.1.09 - Hotfix
notes.content:
We worked on a couple more bugs reported by players.

[h1]BUGS:[/h1][list][*] Levers of a room in Aberrations Chambers were not clearly visible
[*] Some controllers are totally unresponsive after trying to remap THE BUTTONS
[*] Buried Tunnels 1 spawns the Naturalist's and Warrior's unlock rooms and have no rooms to spawn a lever

notes.title: Update 1.1.08 - Hotfix
notes.content:
These bugs are now fixed on the 1.1.08 version. Most of them were reported by players!
Thanks a lot for the help!

[h3]Bugs:[/h3][list][*] Eva projectiles don't move to the bottom of the room when you have the Rabbit's Herb
[*] Double chest spawning on top of the player makes him/her stuck
[*] Fireballs shot by Defiant Flames are too slow
[*] 2 Driders transforming each other at the same time softlock the room
[*] Boomerang stuck on Magnetic
[*] Enemy stuck behind a bookcase in one specific room
[*] Fairy froze Insectoid and he can't be killed anymore
[/list]
Cheers,
-Ed
BEHEMUTT

notes.title: FORGOTTEN CRYPTS - New Major Update! Check out the list of new content
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29687431/a4253667da27ec05b8ad7bd85014b83407312fa3.png[/img]

We're happy to announce we're launching a new DLC called FORGOTTEN CRYPTS!!
Your game should automatically update.

[h1]How much does it cost?[/h1]
For players who gave us their support before the price rise: ZERO!
After the DLC launch, [b]the game base price will have a rise[/b] to reflect the price of the new content.


[h1]ːarrowwː A BRAND NEW CHARACTER[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29687431/dd6b53fdbb059ec9b3f6c589bbbd2549841f80d1.jpg[/img]
She attacks with a boomerang!
The boomerang also marks enemies as target for her loyal dog!!
Galiana, the Naturalist, dedicates her life to study plants and animals and how these can help humans survive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29687431/3e2bbed8cbee416aa2c2b29bc5e7328779bcfef3.gif[/img]

[h1]ːarrowwː NEW SCENARIO & NEW ENEMIES[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29687431/6dff297aaee93a57efb5d231d612331f467dcbf0.png[/img]
New challenging floors to explore and put your strategy to the proof.

[h1]ːarrowwː NEW UNLOCKABLE: SKILLS[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29687431/94b611df6efac00a8dc7af4e2fda9874b8be0a8c.gif[/img]
A new NPC has joined us in the encampment.
He has some valuable knowledge to share about new combat techniques.

[h1]ːarrowwː NEW ITEMS[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29687431/5826655b1e8bb1f3b1ba6a9d1ca25b48878d36e4.png[/img]
We had 31 in total, and we're adding 21 new ones! These are some of our favorites.
We hope this is going to add a lot of variety to the runs.


And one more thing...


[h1]ːarrowwː LOCAL CO-OP MODE[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29687431/4a3f96422ef65d2beb7392dc60da7a2b291bce43.png[/img]
On a Sonic & Tails fashion, now you can explore the dungeons with a friend! The Player 2 gets to control the dog while Player 1 controls any of the 4 characters.
This is not meant to be a hard challenge, but rather a very joyful two-players experience.

[h1]ABOUT SWITCH[/h1]
Qubic Games is the publisher responsible for the porting of Mana Spark on Switch and they're working to port the DLC. They also helped the development with part of the funding, so, it's in their best interest to port the new DLC as fast as possible.
We still don't have a launch date for Switch, but it'll not take long now.


That's it. We worked hard on this and we really hope you like it!
Cheers,
-Ed

notes.title: Quality of Life Update!!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29687431/b932b0c17b0af534dfc220dc4527d3357dfb926d.png[/img]
[h1]Quality of Life Update v1.0.21[/h1]
Since the launch in September we've been updating the game, fixing bugs, removing and adding things players have pointed out to us.

Today what we have is a slightly bigger update that we think will make playing our game a better experience:

[b]New Map Movement System[/b]
Open the map / choose any room already visited / there you are!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29687431/8a4fccdeaa6ec282268b0103110235f291898d6f.png[/img]
[b]Faster movement when out of combat[/b]
More mobility! Can be disabled on Options Menu.

[b]New Poison System[/b]
Stepping on poison won't get you poisoned immediately. It's only fair, right?

[b]Convenient Loot Grab[/b]
Gold and runes are automatically collected after you clear a room. Why not?

[b]Reducing Loading Times[/b]
The game now loads faster between floors.

[b]A Bunch of Bug Fixing[/b]
Some were simple, some were more severe, but what matters is that they've been fixed.

[b]Supported Languages[/b]
We now have:
[list][*] English
[*] Portuguese - Brazil
[*] Russian
[*] French
[*] Spanish - Spain
[*] Spanish - Latin America
[/list]

[h1]A Word About New Content[/h1]
We're not blind. We've seen your feedback on the forums and on reviews requesting new content. New enemies, new items, new areas. It breaks our hearts to read this from players that loved the game, but think the game is not on its full potential because of the lack of content.

And I agree with that.

We've been making some evaluations and we were even talking with a publisher that had some interest on investing on a paid DLC.
The truth is, the sales of the game were not terrible, but it didn't let room for a significant update. If we work on this and it doesn't bring enough results it could put us out of business.

With all that being said, I'd like to know from you:
[list]
[*] What kind of new content would you like to see?
[*] Would you be cool with paying (between 2$ and 5$) for the DLC?
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29687431/a6f9bf0a7f6b7d2bc570284b6c27925ee9192d63.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Game Design Time! - Solving the Backtracking
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29687431/f269f85b59889550834133e485a140dc341dc578.png[/img]

There was a backtracking problem on Mana Spark.
This happened when you had explored an area on the game to find a lever, and then to reach the exit you had to go all the way back to where you were before, in a long boring walk.

Other games that also have this problem usually solve it by allowing the player to teleport somehow, like on Enter the Gungeon or Dead Cells.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29687431/40aa21465de86dbd3448468c1e156c1ff3192e13.png[/img]

But it seemed to be a cheap trick to me.
I didn’t want to introduce random teleports on Mana Spark.

So this is the solution I came with:

[h1]A new Mini Map.[/h1]
Yeah, that’s the solution.
Before our mini map looked like this:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29687431/3bf3786697047903b85eea69b625454247bbeb7d.png[/img]

The rooms of the floor were only revealed once you’d visited them. Everything was hidden. Why? I didn’t had an answer. Because everybody does it like that?

The player had no idea where the rooms were, so he couldn’t plan a good route. That’s what was causing backtracking at first!

So here’s how the new mini map look like:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29687431/8d4d99552d9666ec619b9248d3df67c4636c4825.png[/img]

The floor layout is completely at hand right when you get to it.
You see where the exit is, and can decide where you want to explore first. That way you can make a smarter exploration.

Also now there’re icons that show if there’s still something left in the room. Like a lever or meat. This was a feature requested by some people from the community.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29687431/7263545c49ee3a87117c27ac9fb9cf4830549a64.png[/img]

That’s it for now.
Again, if you liked, leave a comment so I know it’s worth to do this kind of more elaborated post.

Let’s build this together!
-Ed
BEHEMUTT
